sentences.text: Compliance affidavit filed by learned A.G.A. is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.

3. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.312 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Mangalpur, District Kanpur Dehat with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is father-in-law of the deceased.

sentences.text: had taken place about four years prior to the incident.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of the deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons including the applicant.
It was stated that in the first information report no specific role has been assigned to the applicant and only general role was assigned to all the accused persons.

During investigation, on the basis of statement of applicant and co-accused persons, a false version was developed that deceased often used to quarrel with her husband Deel Singh and on the night of the incident, she has created a scene and that co-accused persons have caught hands of deceased and applicant has given a stab blow to the deceased.
There is no eye witness of alleged incident.
The statement of accused made before police is not admissible in evidence.
Alleged recovery of knife shown at the instance of the applicant is false and there is no independent witness to support the said recovery.
5. It is further submitted that the applicant is a 68 years old person and he is suffering from Cancer.

In this connection learned counsel has referred compliance affidavit submitted on behalf of the State, wherein it has been shown that applicant is suffering from "Metastatic Squamous Cells Carcinoma".
It was pointed out that while in custody, applicant is under treatment at KPS PG Institute of Medicine, GSVMMC, Kanpur.
It was submitted that in view of serious illness of applicant, he requires proper treatment, which can only be availed after he comes out on bail.

Lastly,
it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 23.10.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate during trial.
6. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the bail application and submitted that deceased has suffered death due to injuries.
The incident took place within four years of marriage of deceased.
It was submitted that as per statements of applicant and co-accused made before the police, the role of causing incised injuries to deceased with knife has been attributed to the applicant.

7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, all attending facts and circumstances of the case, particularly considering the period of detention and the medical condition of the applicant, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ram Babu involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
